previous_statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation to this eligible raw call and then lem-maincb-reset-output-typing: the resulting v_{U_1} has unchanged source M_1 and target A_{U_1}, is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}-isomorphism because u_0 is bijective, and satisfies d_{U_1} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1} and ||v_{U_1}(I_{M_1})-u_{A_{U_1}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}. These fields and the isomorphism tag form the required def-maincb-reset-state datum.
new_statement: Apply lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation and lem-maincb-reset-output-typing to the same eligible scalar raw call: the former supplies the improved map and its two bounds while preserving bijectivity, and the latter supplies its extended-inclusion typing and hence its extended W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}-isomorphism typing because u_0 is bijective. The output has unchanged source M_1 and target A_{U_1}, satisfies d_{U_1} <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1} and ||v_{U_1}(I_{M_1})-u_{A_{U_1}}|| <= W.c0_cb*epsilon_{U_1}, and these fields and the isomorphism tag form the required def-maincb-reset-state datum.
